title: French Fennel and Sausage Tagine
description: A hearty French-inspired tagine with fennel, sausage, and a hint of anise, perfect for a chilly evening
instructions: Slice the fennel into wedges and set aside.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced fennel to the pot and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the shio, koji, and shattered to the pot. Stir to combine.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
